errors.text_span: bei der die Werte nahe beieinander liegen
errors.evidence: For the category 'Einschränkung/Verlust Geschäftsbeziehungen', the bar for 'übrige Betriebe' (approx. 25%) is visibly longer than for 'Mindestlohnbetriebe' (approx. 23%). Stating that the values are merely 'close' is an over-generalization that obscures the fact that this is the only category where the trend reverses and 'übrige Betriebe' has a higher percentage.
